headline: Western Michigan's attack carries it atop the table
dek: Western Michigan has scored 40 goals across all its matches, more than any other program in the conference, and conceded eighteen. It won twelve, drew four and lost five, and the most recent of those defeats came at Michigan.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: UMass has scored 33 goals, more than every program but Western Michigan, and those same two sit first and second in the conference table: here, attack and standing go together.

wire.line: Fourteen different players have scored for Western Michigan this season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: One match is past its date with no published result, and it is Eastern Michigan's, at home to North Dakota in August.

findings.label: observed

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jadia Kershaw has made 90 saves for Central Michigan, a side that won twice and lost eleven times all season.

findings.label: observed

last_match.line: Western Michigan arrived having won every match since its loss to Miami (Ohio) in October.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
